sources: Новые правила регистрации SIM-карт в Кыргызстане. Ответы на популярные вопросы абонентов
Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Kyrgyz Republic
Obtaining a work permit in the territory of the Kyrgyz Republic (Wayback copy, pre-2025 procedure)

facts.c: A SIM card in Kyrgyzstan can be bought only with a passport, and the number is then registered to the passport online in the operator's app.
facts.q: SIM-карту, как и раньше, можно будет купить только с паспортом, только теперь зарегистрировать номер на себя можно будет онлайн в мобильном приложении любого сотового оператора

facts.c: Until the number is registered to a passport, the SIM only allows calls to the operator and enough internet to download its app.
facts.q: До момента успешной регистрации номера с паспортом услуги связи на новом номере будут ограничены.

facts.c: Those who cannot register online, or have a button phone, register at the operator's sales office with their passport.
facts.q: провести персонификацию номера помогут сотрудники операторов связи в офисах продаж и обслуживания. Приходить нужно обязательно с паспортом.

facts.c: Under the pre-2025 system a work permit file needed an international-standard HIV blood test certificate from the Republican AIDS Center, 8 Logvinenko Street, Bishkek.
facts.q: A medical certificate of a blood test for HIV - infection of an international standard (Republican AIDS Center in Bishkek, at: 8, Logvinenko Street, crosses Bokonbaev Street);
facts.note: Archived MFA page describing the State Migration Service procedure before the 2025 Single Permit; whether the Unified Permit still requires it is not confirmed

facts.c: Under the pre-2025 system the worker's passport had to carry a work visa (category W1) or registration, with a notarised translation.
facts.q: A notarized translation of a copy of a passport of a foreign citizen with a valid visa (I, W1 category) or registration;
facts.note: Pre-2025 procedure; replaced by the Unified Permit
